_comment: Mutations that undo the owner's 2026-11-06 decision: the pricing
fineprint's sentence 'Source available under AGPL v3.' is a LINK to
the AGPL-3.0 section 13 source offer at /source.
M1 removes the anchor, restoring the plain text. This is the decision
being reverted wholesale: the pricing block says the source is
available but no longer takes the reader there.
M2 keeps the anchor but points it at the wrong path, so the link
still LOOKS like an offer link and still lands nowhere.
Both must be killed by tests/test_public_source_offer.py, which pins
the anchor's href and its exact link text, and pins the pricing
prices and tiers so that adding the link moved nothing else.
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: M1: the pricing fineprint's link to the source offer is removed (plain text restored)
M2: the pricing fineprint's offer link points at the wrong path
